meta.project: Módulo de Automação de Tesouraria e Salários

product_overview: An internal finance operations platform that centralizes salary management, document handling, and salary-payment file generation for a company using novobanco and TOConline. It helps users review payroll data, reconcile bank transactions, and export SEPA XML files for bank submission.
core_goals: Review and manage monthly salary data for workers
Generate SEPA XML salary payment files for bank submission
Reconcile bank statement transactions against salary payments
Upload, preview, and request signatures for documents
Approve or reject worker time-entry corrections

features.name: Login
features.description: Allows admin and worker users to sign in with username and password credentials.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill in username -> Fill in password -> Submit the login form -> See the appropriate dashboard after successful sign-in
Navigate to / -> Fill in username -> Fill in password incorrectly -> Submit the login form -> See an invalid-credentials error message

features.name: Salários — Gestão de Salários
features.description: Lets admins select a month, review salary values per worker, add justifications, and inspect salary history.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Open the salaries section -> Select a month -> View expected and actual salary values for each worker -> Add or edit a justification for a salary difference -> Save the justification -> View the updated salary record
Navigate to /admin -> Open the salaries section -> Select a month -> View salary history for a worker -> Review previous monthly salary entries

features.name: Salários — Exportar SEPA XML
features.description: Lets admins select workers and export a SEPA XML file for salary payments, including per-worker amount adjustments.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Open the salaries section -> Select a salary month -> Open the SEPA XML export flow -> Review eligible workers with IBANs -> Select individual workers or select all workers -> Adjust payment amounts if needed -> Export the file -> See the XML file download
Navigate to /admin -> Open the salaries section -> Select a salary month -> Open the SEPA XML export flow -> Select workers -> Export the file -> See the generated XML file download

features.name: Salários — Transferência Imediata (SCT Inst)
features.description: Lets admins export a SEPA XML file marked for immediate credit transfers.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Open the salaries section -> Select a salary month -> Open the immediate transfer export flow -> Select workers -> Confirm the export -> See the immediate-transfer XML file download

features.name: Reconciliação Salarial
features.description: Lets admins import a bank statement CSV and match transactions to employee salary payments.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Open the salary reconciliation section -> Upload a bank statement CSV file -> View auto-matched and unmatched transactions -> Manually associate a transaction to an employee -> Review the updated reconciliation state

features.name: Gestão de Documentos
features.description: Lets admins view documents, upload new files, preview documents, and request signatures.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Open the documents section -> View the documents list -> Upload a new document -> See the document added to the list
Navigate to /admin -> Open the documents section -> View the documents list -> Preview a document -> Review its contents
Navigate to /admin -> Open the documents section -> View the documents list -> Request a signature for a document -> See the signature request state

features.name: Registo de Horas (Admin)
features.description: Lets admins review worker time entries for a selected worker and month, then approve or reject corrections.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Open the time logs section -> Select a worker and month -> View the time entries -> Approve a correction -> See the correction marked as approved
Navigate to /admin -> Open the time logs section -> Select a worker and month -> View the time entries -> Reject a correction -> See the correction marked as rejected

known_limitations.issue: SEPA export requires MINHA_CONTA_IBAN and MINHA_CONTA_BIC environment variables on the API server
known_limitations.impact: Export will fail with 500 error if env vars are not set

known_limitations.issue: SEPA modal only shows workers with expected_amount > 0 for the selected month
known_limitations.impact: Workers without salary data for the month will not appear in export list
